_note: direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for the agencies, monitors and recurring reports.
official  food agencies, safety regulators, courts, WHO, FAO, OECD
research  food system research, nutrition science, investigations
press     general news across the locales
rights    food, health, land and animal organisations
Worth adding, with URLs you have opened: IPES-Food, ETC Group, Food and Water
Watch, the Access to Nutrition Initiative, Changing Markets, Feedback Global,
Compassion in World Farming, the Organic Center, and national food agencies.
